text: What is the lower explosive limit (LEL) of Methane (CH4) gas in normal mine atmospheric air?
textHindi: सामान्य खदान वायु में मीथेन (CH4) गैस की निचली विस्फोटक सीमा (LEL) क्या है?
textSantali: ᱠᱷᱟᱫᱟᱱ ᱨᱮ ᱢᱤᱛᱷᱮᱱ ᱜᱮᱥ (CH4) ᱨᱮᱱᱟᱜ ᱵᱷᱩᱲᱠᱟᱹᱜ ᱥᱤᱢᱟᱹ (LEL) ᱫᱚ ᱛᱤᱱᱟᱹᱜ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ?
options: 5.0% (Explosive range: 5% to 15%)
explanation: Methane is flammable and explosive between 5.0% and 15.0% in atmospheric air with sufficient oxygen.

text: Why does Methane (CH4) typically accumulate in upper roof cavities rather than floor sumps?
textHindi: मीथेन गैस फर्श के बजाय खदान की छत के ऊपरी हिस्सों में क्यों जमा होती है?
textSantali: ᱢᱤᱛᱷᱮᱱ ᱜᱮᱥ ᱞᱟᱛᱟᱨ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱡᱟᱨᱣᱟ ᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱪᱮᱛᱟᱱ ᱪᱷᱟᱛ ᱨᱮ ᱪᱮᱫᱟᱜ ᱡᱟᱨᱣᱟᱜᱼᱟ?
options: It is attracted by roof support iron bolts
It is lighter than air (Specific Gravity ~0.55 relative to air)
It dissolves in roof dripping water
Ventilation fans pull it upward
explanation: Because methane has a specific gravity of ~0.55 (much lighter than air), it forms explosive layers along roof voids.

text: What is the minimum permissible oxygen concentration for safe worker occupancy underground?
textHindi: श्रमिकों के काम करने के लिए न्यूनतम सुरक्षित ऑक्सीजन स्तर क्या है?
textSantali: ᱠᱟᱹᱢᱤᱭᱟᱹ ᱠᱚ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ ᱠᱚᱢ ᱠᱷᱚᱱ ᱠᱚᱢ ᱛᱤᱱᱟᱹᱜ ᱚᱠᱥᱤᱡᱮᱱ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸᱱ ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤᱭᱟ?
options: 19.5% by volume
explanation: DGMS safety rules specify an atmosphere containing less than 19.5% O2 is oxygen-deficient and hazardous.

text: At what percentage of Methane in return air must all electrical power be cut off automatically?
textHindi: रिटर्न वायु में मीथेन का स्तर कितने प्रतिशत पहुंचने पर बिजली की आपूर्ति तुरंत बंद कर दी जानी चाहिए?
textSantali: ᱨᱩᱣᱟᱹᱲ ᱦᱚᱭ ᱨᱮ ᱢᱤᱛᱷᱮᱱ ᱛᱤᱱᱟᱹᱜ % ᱥᱮᱴᱮᱨ ᱞᱮᱱᱠᱷᱟᱱ ᱵᱤᱡᱽᱞᱤ ᱚᱴᱳᱢᱮᱴᱤᱠ ᱵᱚᱸᱫᱽ ᱦᱩᱭᱩᱜᱼᱟ?
options: 1.25% (DGMS Reg 169)
explanation: Under Coal Mines Regulations 2017, if CH4 exceeds 1.25% in the general body of return air, electrical power must be immediately isolated.

text: Before entering a blind unventilated heading, what is the first safety action required?
textHindi: अहवादित (Unventilated) क्षेत्र में प्रवेश करने से पहले पहला कदम क्या होना चाहिए?
textSantali: ᱦᱚᱭ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱪᱟᱞᱟᱜ ᱠᱟᱱ ᱡᱟᱭᱜᱟ ᱨᱮ ᱵᱚᱞᱚᱱ ᱢᱟᱬᱟᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱠᱟᱹᱢᱤ ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤᱭᱟ?
options: Enter quickly to inspect the rock face
Test multi-gas atmospheric concentrations at roof, mid-height, and floor from outside the danger zone
Switch on electric drilling machines
Spray water onto the floor
explanation: Never enter without prior multi-level gas sampling for CH4, CO, H2S, and O2 levels.

text: What is the purpose of an intrinsically safe (IS) certification on electronic mine equipment?
textHindi: इलेक्ट्रॉनिक खनन उपकरणों पर 'इंट्रिन्सिकली सेफ' (IS) प्रमाणन का क्या उद्देश्य है?
textSantali: ᱠᱷᱟᱫᱟᱱ ᱥᱟᱢᱟᱱ ᱨᱮ 'Intrinsically Safe' (IS) ᱨᱮᱱᱟᱜ ᱢᱮᱱᱮᱛ ᱫᱚ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ?
options: Ensures equipment is waterproof up to 100 meters
Guarantees that electrical energy and sparks generated are incapable of igniting flammable methane-air mixtures
Prevents dust from entering the camera lens
Allows the device to transmit cellular 5G signals underground
explanation: IS design limits thermal and electrical energy so no spark can exceed the minimum ignition energy of methane.

text: Which gas is known as 'Stinkdamp' due to its characteristic rotten-egg odor?
textHindi: सड़े अंडे जैसी गंध के कारण किस गैस को 'स्टिंकडैम्प' (Stinkdamp) कहा जाता है?
textSantali: ᱥᱮᱭᱟ ᱵᱤᱞᱤ ᱞᱮᱠᱟ ᱥᱚᱜ ᱠᱷᱟᱹᱛᱤᱨ ᱚᱠᱟ ᱜᱮᱥ 'Stinkdamp' ᱠᱚ ᱢᱮᱛᱟᱜᱼᱟ?
options: Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S)
Carbon Dioxide (CO2)
Nitrogen Dioxide (NO2)
Methane (CH4)
explanation: Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) has a strong rotten egg odor at low levels, but rapidly deadens olfactory senses at dangerous concentrations (>50 PPM).

text: What should a worker do immediately if a personal 4-gas monitor sounds a continuous high-pitch alarm?
textHindi: यदि व्यक्तिगत गैस मॉनिटर लगातार उच्च अलार्म बजाने लगे तो तुरंत क्या करना चाहिए?
textSantali: ᱡᱩᱫᱤ ᱜᱮᱥ ᱰᱤᱴᱮᱠᱴᱚᱨ ᱜᱷᱟᱹᱱᱴᱤ ᱡᱚᱨ ᱛᱮ ᱥᱟᱰᱮᱜᱼᱟ, ᱛᱚᱵᱮ ᱞᱚᱜᱚᱱ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱠᱟᱹᱢᱤ ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤᱭᱟ?
options: Mute the buzzer and continue loading coal
Immediately shout warning to coworkers, don breathing apparatus/SCSR, and retreat along the intake fresh airway
Remove the battery to reset calibration
Wait 10 minutes to verify if the reading drops
explanation: Treat every high gas alarm as an active lethal emergency; alert coworkers and evacuate immediately.

text: What is the primary danger of Carbon Monoxide (CO) gas in underground atmospheres?
textHindi: भूमिगत वातावरण में कार्बन मोनोऑक्साइड (CO) गैस का मुख्य खतरा क्या है?
textSantali: ᱠᱟᱨᱵᱚᱱ ᱢᱳᱱᱳᱠᱥᱟᱭᱤᱰ (CO) ᱜᱮᱥ ᱪᱮᱫᱟᱜ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱵᱚᱛᱚᱨᱟᱱ ᱜᱮᱭᱟ?
options: It is visible as bright blue vapor
It is colorless, odorless, and binds to blood hemoglobin 200x faster than oxygen, causing rapid asphyxiation
It corrodes rubber conveyor belts
It extinguishes miners' cap lamp LED bulbs
explanation: CO forms carboxyhemoglobin, depriving vital organs and the brain of oxygen without olfactory warning.

text: How often must portable multi-gas detectors be bump-tested and span-calibrated in mine safety lamps rooms?
textHindi: पोर्टेबल मल्टी-गैस डिटेक्टरों की बम्प-टेस्टिंग और कैलिब्रेशन कितने समय में की जानी चाहिए?
textSantali: ᱜᱮᱥ ᱰᱤᱴᱮᱠᱴᱚᱨ ᱴᱷᱤᱠ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱜᱼᱟ ᱥᱮ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱛᱤᱱᱟᱹᱜ ᱫᱤᱱ ᱨᱮ ᱴᱮᱥᱴ ᱦᱩᱭᱩᱜᱼᱟ?
options: Daily bump test before every underground shift & monthly span calibration
Once a year during annual audit
Only after an underground fire incident
Every 5 years
explanation: DGMS rules mandate a daily bump test prior to issuing lamps/detectors to workers and monthly full calibration.
